props.text: No robot is at the conveyor while the belt moves
CYCLE START only with the door closed and the guard locked
Robot 1 is inside the CNC only with the door open and the spindle stopped
The door is opened only after the cycle, with the guard lock released
A part is placed on the conveyor only at a free entry of a stopped belt
Robot 2 places a part only on an output pallet that is in place and not full
An undersized part never reaches the output pallet
No CYCLE START during a quality hold
Three mismatches in the window always stop the line
A camera fault always stops the line
Robot 2 loads the gauge nest (part or master cube) only when it is empty
A part is measured only after a passed master check
Robot 1 enters the CNC and CYCLE START is sent only with the CNC ready (no alarm)
No CYCLE START while the tool change is due
The line never resumes with a sensor whose test failed
No robot job runs during an E-stop or before the safety relay is reset
No robot job in a loading zone is started while a person is in its protective field
A new CNC cycle can always be started again
Robot 2 can always deliver a part again
After any stop the supervisor can return to NORMAL
